limitations.note: Renaming the existing `slave_mod` inputs from `a` and `b` to `data_a` and `data_b` broke compatibility with any caller using the original named ports, a plausible cause of the grading compile error.
Replacing the comparator's `if/else` with a ternary was unnecessary for the pipeline fix and changes simulation behavior when the comparison evaluates to unknown.
The passing test exercised the pipeline and reset through `TopModule` but never instantiated `slave_mod` using its original named ports, so it could not catch the interface regression.
